name: Pack Hunter
summary: Pack hunter barbarians team up to hunt dangerous prey to feed, to protect their camps, and as a rite of passage.
replacesText: Rage Powers; Trap Sense; 6th-level Rage Power

features.name: Bonus Feats
features.summary: Whenever a pack hunter would gain a new rage power, she can instead select a teamwork feat . She must still meet the prerequisites for the teamwork feat. This alters rage power.

features.name: In and Out (Ex)
features.summary: At 3rd level, a pack hunter gains a +1 dodge bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity. This bonus increases by 1 for every 3 barbarian levels after 3rd (to a maximum bonus of +6 at 18th level). This replaces trap sense.

features.name: Sympathetic Rage (Ex)
features.summary: At 6th level, if an ally within 30 feet is bloodraging or raging, a pack hunter counts as raging even if knocked unconscious. She has to have been raging when incapacitated to maintain her rage, and she ceases raging normally if she depletes her maximum number of rounds of rage in a day. This replaces the rage power normally gained at 6th level.

features.name: Rage Powers
features.summary: The following rage powers complement the pack hunter archetype: contagious rage, increased damage reduction, no escape, pack rage, quick reflexes, and unexpected strike.
